testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-040 EDG-028: No Estimate Shipping Cost section when the store setting is No

scenario.summary: With store BNJM set to Show Estimate Shipping Cost Section = No, a created Sales Rep (Shop As) with an item sees no Estimate Shipping Cost section, zip estimate field or estimated amount, and Delivery shows only the default shipping method and its information.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@user.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown
Enter 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Redeem Now
Look for an Estimate Shipping section, a zip code estimate field or an estimated amount (SAN-040 steps 3-4, EDG-028 step 2)
Check Delivery shows only the default shipping method and its information (EDG-028 step 3)
stateChanges: The Sales Rep user and its allotment are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart line added by Redeem Now
assertions: No Estimate Shipping Cost section, estimate field, shipping cost field or estimated amount is shown
Delivery shows only one shipping method with its information and no cost (expected values: P4)
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-040, EDG-028 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it

Precondition 'Show Estimate Shipping Cost Section = No, published' waits for a read-only key of the store attribute ShowEstimateShippingCost (P5, not built; qa value is false today, analysis section 9)

Delivery method: the expected method name and information wait for a read-only key of store BNJM's default shipping method (P4, not built: where Admin stores the default on BNJM is unknown, analysis section 9). Until it exists the test checks the heading 'Delivery', that one shipping method with its information is shown and that no cost or price wording is shown, not which method it is

Partially automated: the Admin steps (confirm the setting in Additional Store Attributes, save and publish; SAN-040 steps 1-2, EDG-028 step 1) are a store change and are not done (analysis 1d, decision Q8)

Not covered (test author report on the spec (framework branch dev_BMP94, 75b25168, 2026-11-27)): the exact name of the store default shipping method is not compared; P4 (SHIPPING_DEFAULT_OF_STORE) is open because the default flag is not in ZnodePortalShipping or a mapped table (analysis section 11). The test checks that Delivery shows one method without cost - partially automated

Not covered (test author report on the spec (framework branch dev_BMP94, 75b25168, 2026-11-27)): the P5 precondition (Show Estimate Shipping Cost Section = No, published) is not checked through a declared need, and the Admin confirm-and-publish steps of SAN-040 / EDG-028 are not done - partially automated
